messages:
tej: Seeing apiserver p99 jump in sa-east1 around 17:20, controller-manager backlog rising, and multiple etcd leader switches. RTT variance between control-plane nodes is wild.
rachel: I grabbed a short tcpdump between ctrl-a and ctrl-b, looks like ICMP frag-needed and a bunch of SYN retransmits. possible MTU regression or ICMP being filtered.
omar: GPU provisioner shows ~110 Pending pods with AttachVolume timeouts. controller manager requeues are contributing to the fanout. we need a mitigation that doesn't touch existing scheduled work.
tej: immediate mitigation: reduce controller-manager sync concurrency and divert new best-effort GPU claims to us-east1 until network is fixed. keep critical jobs unchanged.
rachel: patching controller-manager args now: `--concurrent-deployment-syncs=2 --concurrent-replicaset-syncs=1`.
sre-bot: patch applied by rachel at 1910001310.
omar: adding placement override annotation on provisioner: `prov.redwood/placement-fallback=us-east1:20%` targetting pods labeled `workload=best-effort`. Applied at 1910001330.
infra-net: we see a transient MTU change on a peering path due to an automated config push; ICMP rate-limit policy also dropped some frag-needed responses. rolling back the change and disabling ICMP rate-limit for control-plane corridors. opening NET-4331.
tej: tcpdump excerpt:
```
17:21:05.210 IP ctrl-a > ctrl-b: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1380], length 0
17:21:05.412 IP ctrl-b > ctrl-a: frag-needed icmp (mtu 1400)
17:21:05.615 IP ctrl-a > ctrl-b: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, length 0 (retransmit)
```
rachel: metrics: apiserver_p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 580ms within 4m after both changes. pending GPUs down 110 -> 36. etcd leader churn stopped.
omar: cost note: diverting ~25 vGPUs adds ~0.09$/GPU-hr (spot + egress). ~25*0.09 = 2.25$/hr (~54$/day) while canary runs. logging COST-7401.
infra-net: rollback in progress, ICMP policy updated. will monitor for 30m. NET-4331 created at 1910001390.
tej: plan: keep placement override for 30m, keep controller concurrency reduced for 15m, then revert in controlled steps if stable. rachel/omar please capture pod lists that were moved for the postmortem.
rachel: will export lists and attach to NET-4331.
omar: will draft a short incident note and cost appendix.
sre-bot: action: placement-override/gpu-us-east-canary created by omar at 1910001330.
